title: Count Salary Categories
scenario: Categorize accounts into 'Low Salary' (< 20000), 'Average Salary' (20000-50000), and 'High Salary' (> 50000).
hint: Use UNION to ensure all categories appear even if the count is 0.
correctQuery: SELECT 'Low Salary' AS category, COUNT(*) AS accounts_count FROM Accounts WHERE income < 20000 UNION SELECT 'Average Salary', COUNT(*) FROM Accounts WHERE income BETWEEN 20000 AND 50000 UNION SELECT 'High Salary', COUNT(*) FROM Accounts WHERE income > 50000;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE Accounts (account_id INT, income INT); INSERT INTO Accounts VALUES (1, 3000), (2, 25000), (3, 60000);
